visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, reddish-brown hair, wearing a black Stitch-themed t-shirt, sits on a light gray fabric sofa. She holds three Stitch-branded snack tins: a large blue one shaped like Stitch's head and two smaller circular ones in yellow and light blue. To her right sits a large blue Stitch plush toy. (2) The camera zooms in as she places the blue circular tin on her lap and opens it, showing a lid featuring a cartoon Stitch. She pulls out a silver foil-wrapped cookie and shows a round, golden-brown biscuit with an embossed Stitch face before taking a bite. (3) She switches to the yellow circular tin, opening it to reveal similar silver packaging. She extracts a round, yellow pastry, which she identifies as a pineapple cake, and bites into it, displaying the dark filling. (4) She presents the large blue head-shaped tin, then shows its internal tray containing several chocolate egg rolls and a chocolate cookie. She tastes a chocolate egg roll and then shows the dark chocolate cookie to the camera while continuing to speak with expressive facial movements.
